from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u043/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
path=progdir/'task-99bebab6.py'
source='''from collections import Counter

def _runs(row, bg):
    out=[]
    i=0
    while i < len(row):
        if row[i] == bg:
            i += 1
            continue
        color=row[i]
        j=i+1
        while j < len(row) and row[j] == color:
            j += 1
        out.append((i,j-1,color))
        i=j
    return out

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    top=_runs(g[0],bg)
    bottom=_runs(g[-1],bg)
    # The two matching edge bars are the non-background runs at opposite ends.
    if not top or not bottom:
        return g
    t=top[0]
    b=bottom[-1]
    if t[2] != b[2] or (t[1]-t[0]) != (b[1]-b[0]):
        return g
    bar=t[2]
    markers=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (bg,bar)]
    for r,c,color in markers:
        # Each marker selects the matching position in the opposite edge bar.
        if t[0] <= c <= t[1]:
            idx=c-t[0]
            paired=b[0]+idx
            toward_top=True
        elif b[0] <= c <= b[1]:
            idx=c-b[0]
            paired=t[0]+idx
            toward_top=False
        else:
            continue
        for rr in range(h):
            if g[rr][paired] not in (bar,):
                g[rr][paired]=color
        # Extend the marker's color along its column to its own edge bar.
        if toward_top:
            rr_range=range(r-1,0,-1)
        else:
            rr_range=range(r+1,h-1)
        for rr in rr_range:
            if g[rr][c] not in (bar,):
                g[rr][c]=color
        g[r][c]=4
    return g
'''
path.write_text(source)
print(path)
